purpose: Provide a reviewable document register for AkashicNET RV and TSC2026 research, with attributed findings, access limits and version relationships.

scope.counting_rule: Eight index entries are not eight experiments. Utts and Hyman share the AIR container/evidence; SRI reports overlap. Different archival manifestations are not independent corroboration.
scope.selection: One programme evaluation with two contrasting expert contributions; two original SRI experimental reports; one methodological assessment; one unfavourable and one favourable operational record.
scope.completion: Selected OCR/text passages only, except the two substantive pages of the short JCS evaluation. No full-archive, full-book or raw-data review.

integration.category_basis: Existing PSI research lane: inaccessible-target information without an identified sender. This is a discovery mapping, not an accepted evidence edge.
integration.sender_boundary: Target-person/sender protocols require TEL review; heterogeneous reports do not transfer wholesale to RV.

proposed_contextual_links.title: Does consciousness continue beyond the individual?
proposed_contextual_links.rationale: These living-person information tasks do not test postmortem survival.

proposed_contextual_links.title: Where do thoughts come from?
proposed_contextual_links.rationale: Cueing, memory, inference and judging controls inform how claimed information sources would need to be distinguished; no mechanism is established.

excluded_question.title: Can Love Harmonise Consciousness With the Cosmos?
excluded_question.reason: No examined protocol tests a love intervention; no direct evidentiary mapping proposed.

reddit_connection.note: The single RV Reddit manifestation belongs to a bounded census, not to a count of AkashicNET historical coverage.

rights_and_access.permission_basis: Reviewable metadata-only repository contribution; no merge or website publication performed.
rights_and_access.current_restrictions: Direct CIA document URLs redirected in this environment; some records have redactions. Third-party scans and author copies have independent terms. Publication rights for source text/images were not cleared.
rights_and_access.handling: Links, identifiers and short attributed paraphrases only. No PDF, page image, source OCR or recovered redactions imported. Do not reidentify redacted personnel.
rights_and_access.mirror_authenticity: Identifiers, title/author/date and release markings were checked in available text; no byte-for-byte comparison with a currently downloadable official file or complete visual authentication.

records.review_scope: Cover, contents and selected early experimental descriptions; not all experiments or appendices
records.research_methods: Coordinate/client-target trials, travelling target-person exercises and local training with feedback.

reported_outcomes.summary: Interim descriptions include apparent correspondences, partial matches and misses; client evaluation was incomplete. The report distinguishes feedback training from an ability test.

records.limitations: Mixed protocols and incomplete evaluation prevent a uniform success measure; feedback trials cannot be treated as blind validation.
